instructions: See docs/ratings.md. Give every season a rating on the absolute scale. Rate the player that season, never their career.

seasons.note: Eighteen, technically advanced and already comfortable in possession at the top level; the good WBA midfielder was clearly visible.
A World Cup and European Championship winner arriving at thirty-three; the legs had gone but the touch and passing were still a division above anything else at the club.
The one season the injuries left him alone long enough to show what he was: six goals from central midfield and, in stretches, unplayable.
Twelve goals from fifteen starts as a 22-year-old; a real step up from the fringe player of the previous season rather than a scoring fluke.
Comfortably the most technically gifted player in a relegated West Brom side; a capped Wales playmaker with genuine top-flight passing, held back by inconsistency rather than ability.
Twenty-four league goals in his first English season and third in the Ballon d’Or; pace, movement and finishing all world class at the same time.
A quick, sensible young full-back at Arsenal; sound rather than good.
Spurs player of the season in a fourth-place finish: the reflexes were always elite, and this was the year the errors stopped outweighing them.
A January loan from Roma who started strongly; a genuinely gifted centre-forward, already a fixture for Egypt, with an obvious temperament problem.
Converted from a raw centre-half into Arsenal’s holding midfielder, and by this season the best player at the club in that position.
